lines.say: January exams? Three things to do this week.
One. Close the solution, and explain the method out loud.
Two. Mix your topics. The exam won't say which method it wants.
Three. Go back to the first topic you did. That's the one you've forgotten.
Offload does number one: it makes you explain each method, from your notes.
And number three? That's the one nobody does.
Offload does that one too. It brings old topics back before you forget.
It plans every session. You just click the link in your calendar.
